states that when a channel is archived while archived channels are NOT viewable, the user is removed from it (and kicked out if it is the current channel); when viewable, the channel is kept and marked deleted
decisions.detail: QUOTE: "Archive a channel | `app/actions/remote/channel.ts:1397-1401` | Sets `delete_at` locally and keeps the user as a member | Removes the current user from the channel locally" and "If the archived channel is current, emits `CHANNEL_ARCHIVED` and kicks the user out; then removes the user from the channel" | WHY: The answer states that when viewing archived channels is disabled, the user is removed from the channel and kicked out if it is current. When enabled, the channel is kept with `delete_at` set, which matches "marked deleted". || QUOTE: "Archive a channel | `app/actions/remote/channel.ts:1397-1401` | Sets `delete_at` locally and keeps the user as a member | Removes the current user from the channel locally" and "Archive event from websocket | ... | If the archived channel is current, emits `CHANNEL_ARCHIVED` and kicks the user out; then removes the user from the channel" | WHY: The answer states that when archived channels aren't viewable, the user is removed from the channel and kicked out if it is current; when viewable, `delete_at` is set locally (channel marked deleted) and the user stays a member. || QUOTE: "Archive a channel | `app/actions/remote/channel.ts:1397-1401` | Sets `delete_at` locally and keeps the user as a member | Removes the current user from the channel locally" and "If the archived channel is current, emits `CHANNEL_ARCHIVED` and kicks the user out; then removes the user from the channel" | WHY: The answer states that when viewing is disabled the user is removed from the channel and kicked out if it is current, and that when viewable the channel gets `delete_at` set and is kept.
